# tink-cc / tink_encrypt_fuzzer

OSS-Fuzz's fuzz target `tink_encrypt_fuzzer` ([source](source/tink_encrypt_decrypt_fuzzer.cc), unmodified) over tink-cc (tink-crypto/tink-cc at 527baad6).

Checks one property, an API contract: AES-SIV EncryptDeterministically with a fixed valid 64-byte key must succeed on every message: ct.value() on a non-OK StatusOr throws absl::BadStatusOrAccess (uncaught -> std::terminate) or aborts when exceptions are off. (res.value() on New(key) is the same check on a constant key, trivially true.).

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against tink-cc at commit 527baad6 with 1 patch to the library (listed on the project page).
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- AES-SIV EncryptDeterministically with a fixed valid 64-byte key must succeed on every message: ct.value() on a non-OK StatusOr throws absl::BadStatusOrAccess (uncaught -> std::terminate) or aborts when exceptions are off. (res.value() on New(key) is the same check on a constant key, trivially true.) ([lines 27-28](source/tink_encrypt_decrypt_fuzzer.cc#L27-L28)): an uncaught exception; not confirmed in the binary.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch tink-cc` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
